init.description: Travel limits reported by the desk: {limits}.

data_description.min_height: Height for cover position 0 (closed). Empty: the desk's lower limit.
data_description.max_height: Height for cover position 100 (open). Empty: the desk's upper limit.
data_description.idle_timeout: Seconds to keep the connection after the last move, then release it so the vendor app can connect.
data_description.connection_mode: On demand: connect for each command, release after the idle time (the vendor app can connect in between; after about an hour without activity the desk sleeps until a handset key is pressed). Keep awake: on demand, plus a short connection at the interval below so the desk never goes to sleep. Always connected: hold the connection for live height updates and the quickest response; the vendor app cannot connect.
data_description.keep_awake_interval: Keep awake mode only. Must stay below the desk's standby time of about 60 minutes.
data_description.expose_cover: Adds a cover entity with a position slider. Off by default: "close all covers" (in an area or the whole home) would also move the desk.

error.min_above_max: The lowest height must be below the highest height

unreachable.title: {name} is not reachable over Bluetooth
unreachable.description:
Home Assistant has not heard {name} for several minutes, although its connection mode should keep it awake.

If the desk still moves with its handset, its Bluetooth module has probably hung: unplug the desk for about 10 seconds, then plug it back in. Otherwise check that a Bluetooth adapter or proxy that supports connections is in range and switched on (Settings → Bluetooth).

This notice disappears as soon as the desk is heard again.

no_connectable_scanner.title: {name} is only heard by Bluetooth scanners that cannot connect
no_connectable_scanner.description:
Home Assistant hears {name} only through Bluetooth scanners that can listen but not connect (for example Shelly devices), so it cannot control the desk.

Check that a Bluetooth adapter or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy with `bluetooth_proxy: active: true` is switched on near the desk, and that it actually receives: under Settings → Bluetooth its list of discovered devices should not be empty. Restarting a proxy that stopped receiving often helps.

This notice disappears as soon as a scanner that can connect hears the desk again.
